accounts.title: Accounts
acct.add.key.note: This key is not part of any recovery phrase. Back it up separately.
acct.sync.hint.body: Watch and hardware accounts sync; seeds and keys never do. Pair in Settings › Devices.
activity.empty: Nothing yet. Sends, swaps and everything the wallet signs will appear here, with what you were shown when you signed.
activity.title: Activity
alerts.body: Star a token, collection or campaign from Explore, then set what to tell you about. Rewards to collect and dividends to claim are mentioned once a day on their own. Nothing here nags.
alerts.onLive: Tell me when it goes live
alerts.push.denied: Notifications are off for BoltVault in the system settings.
alerts.push.granted: On. Incoming funds, sales and offers, campaigns going live, rewards and dividends arrive while the app is closed.
alerts.push.off.body: Off. Turn it on to hear about incoming funds, sales, campaigns and rewards while the app is closed. Only a type and an id ever travel; the app fetches the details.
alerts.push.web: The extension checks in the background on its own; push is for the phone.
alerts.title: Notifications
allow.summary.body: {n} contracts can move tokens from this account.
allow.summary.empty: Nothing can move your tokens without a signature.
allow.title: Approvals
approval.blocked: BoltVault will not sign this. See why above.
approval.connect.body: The site will see this address and can ask you to sign. It cannot move anything without a signature.
approval.none.body: This request was already decided or has expired.
approval.nopreview: No balance preview on this network — only the revert check ran.
approval.watch.body: Add a token this site suggests to your list. Its details are checked against the chain before it shows.
backup.body: Enter your password to show the words, write them down, then confirm three of them.
backup.done: Backed up. Swapping and signing are unlocked.
backup.none: Every seed in this vault is backed up.
backup.title: Back up your recovery phrase
bridge.approve: Two signatures: allow the Hyperlane router to take the tokens, then bridge.
bridge.asset.name: Hyperlane {s}
bridge.explorer: Look it up on explorer.hyperlane.xyz with message {id}
bridge.none: No Hyperlane corridor starts on this chain. USDC moves between Electroneum, Ethereum, Base and Avalanche; USDT between Electroneum and Ethereum.
bridge.recipient.contract: This address is a contract on both chains.
bridge.recipient.nocode: A contract here, nothing on the destination — the tokens would be stuck.
bridge.state.dispatched: Dispatched — watching the destination for delivery
bridge.title: Bridge
browser.title: Browser
browser.web: The in-app browser is a phone feature. In the browser extension, BoltVault is already in every tab — open the site and connect from there.
campaign.cancelled: Cancelled by the team — contributions are refundable
campaign.contribute.body: Contributions are native ETN. If the campaign reaches its target you claim tokens after launch; if not, you claim a refund.
campaign.contribute.title: Contribute ETN
campaign.failed: Did not reach its target — contributions are refundable
campaign.ref: Share your link — you earn {p}% of contributions
campaign.refEarned: {a} ETN in referral rewards to claim
campaign.star: Tell me when it goes live
campaign.target: {p}% of the {t} ETN launch target · {n} contributors
collection.mint.body: {p} ETN each · {n} left for you · {s} minted
device.blind: The device shows the amount and the address; the data is a hash, so use the statements above as the truth. Blind signing must be on in the Ethereum app.
device.message: The device shows the message text.
device.plain: A plain send: the device shows exactly these fields.
device.typed: The device shows two hashes (domain and message) — the statements above are what they mean.
devices.answer.show: Show this to the first device, then compare the codes.
devices.answer.title: Scan the other device’s code
devices.offer.then: Then scan (or paste) the answer it shows.
devices.offer.title: Scan this on the other device
devices.requests.body: An account whose key lives on another paired device signs there: the request opens as a signing sheet on that device, and the answer comes back here. Only you can approve it, and only after reading what it signs.
devices.requests.in: From {d} · {k} — open in the signing sheet
devices.sas.body: Both devices show a six-digit code. Confirm only if they match exactly.
devices.sas.title: Compare the codes
devices.title: Devices & sync
devices.what: Paired devices share settings, per-site chains and watch/hardware accounts. Seeds and keys never sync — move a vault with the export code in Security.
explore.off.body: Prices, collections and campaigns come from ElectroSwap, which this build cannot reach yet. Your balances, sends and swaps still work.
explore.off.title: Markets are on Electroneum
explore.title: Explore Electroneum
farm.cb.body: Collect your DYNO, swap it for BOLT, then deposit BOLT as a boost with your next deposit. Boosts land on the 50,000 or 100,000 BOLT stairs — you need {b} more for {m}×.
farm.cb.title: Collect & boost
farm.deposit.title: Deposit
farm.dilution: A second deposit re-weights your duration bonus: {a}× today → {b}× after this deposit. It climbs again from there.
farm.none: Deposit both sides of the pair to start earning DYNO. Your multiplier grows with time and with BOLT deposited as a boost.
farm.ratio: The pool sets the ratio; unused amounts come back to you.
farm.steps: {n} signature{s}: the farm is allowed to pull each token once, then the deposit.
farm.title: Farm
farm.w.bolt: {b} BOLT boost comes back — it only unlocks when you withdraw everything
farm.w.keeps: You keep your duration multiplier. BOLT unlocks only when you withdraw everything.
farm.withdraw.title: Withdraw
fee.score: {s} BOLT-eq — {w} in your wallet, {f} deposited in farms, {d} from DYNO
fee.sheet.body: Every in-wallet swap pays a fee on what you receive. The more BOLT you hold — in your wallet or deposited as a farm boost — the less you pay. The schedule lives on chain; the wallet reads it live.
fee.sheet.fallback: The schedule contract did not answer; these are the published defaults and you pay the base rate until it does.
fee.sheet.title: Wallet fee schedule
fee.sink: Fees go to the fee sink {a}. What it does with them is published in About.
fee.sink.none: The fee sink for this network is not set yet; in-wallet swaps stay off until it is.
fee.top: Top tier — the lowest fee there is.
feel.haptics.hint: A light tick on confirm and keys, medium on a receipt, heavy on danger.
feel.motion.hint: The Field holds still, digits update without rolling, the discharge is a short fade. The app is complete without motion.
feel.sound.hint: Three sounds: a confirm, a receive, an error. Nothing else.
feel.tick.hint: One light tap every five seconds while Home is open. Off unless you like it.
flow.approve: Allow the contract to pull the tokens
flow.approveCollection: Let the marketplace move this collection
flow.failed.title: The network refused it
flow.rejected.title: Nothing was signed
home.backup.body: Swapping and signing stay locked until you confirm three words. Watching and receiving work now.
home.backup.title: Back up your recovery phrase
home.create.body: Create a new recovery phrase or import one you already have. Electroneum is your home chain.
home.create.title: Your vault is not created yet
home.fund.body: This is Electroneum Smart Chain (52014). Send ETN here from an exchange that supports the smart chain, or bridge USDC from Ethereum — you will need a little ETN for fees.
home.fund.title: Receive ETN to get started
home.locked.body: Unlock to see balances and sign.
home.locked.title: Locked
home.positions.empty: No farm positions, open orders or bridges in flight.
keystone.body: Scan this with the Keystone, check {what} on its screen, then scan its answer here.
keystone.import.body: On the Keystone choose Connect software wallet › BoltVault (or any EVM wallet) and scan the QR it shows. Signing later works the same way: a QR each way, nothing plugged in.
keystone.paste: No camera here? Paste the UR text of the answer.
keystone.title: Sign on your Keystone
ledger.blind: Swaps and contract calls need blind signing: Ethereum app › Settings › Blind signing on the device. Plain sends work without it.
ledger.body: Plug in your Ledger, unlock it and open the Ethereum app. Your keys never leave the device; BoltVault only shows you what it will sign.
ledger.openapp: Open the Ethereum app on the device.
ledger.unavailable: Ledger over USB works from the full tab in Chrome, and over Bluetooth on the phone. In this window you can watch its address, or sign on a paired device.
legends.activate.body: {n} of your pieces are not earning yet — activate them once and they share every fee from then on.
legends.body: Marketplace fees shared with holders. Fees keep flowing in; the vessel fills until you claim.
legends.how: How it works: the marketplace fee receiver is the dividend distributor. It keeps two thirds for ElectroSwap and credits one third to every registered Legend. Claiming pays the ETN straight to you; there is no allowance involved.
legends.lifetime: Lifetime paid to Legends holders: {a} ETN
legends.none: You hold no Electric Legends yet. Every Legend shares a third of the marketplace fees, forever.
legends.share: Your share of the next fee: {p}%
legends.title: Electric Legends dividends
limit.above: {p}% above market — fills when the price gets there
limit.below: {p}% below market — a swap would pay more right now
limit.fee: Platform fee 0.1% on fill · no wallet fee
limit.market.none: No market rate for this pair right now.
limit.none: No open orders. An order waits on chain until the price reaches your target or it expires.
moments.title: Signature moments
networks.body: Electroneum is home and always on. Other chains show balances, send, receive, activity and approvals through public RPCs; swaps and markets stay on Electroneum.
networks.rpc.bad: That RPC did not answer with this chain id.
networks.testnet.hint: Chain 5201420. Test ETN has no value; names do not resolve there.
ob.done.body: Send ETN here from an exchange that supports the smart chain, or bridge USDC from Ethereum — you will need a little ETN for fees. Do not send from the old Electroneum app.
ob.done.title: This is Electroneum Smart Chain (52014)
ob.hardware.note: Ledger, Trezor and Keystone accounts are added from the Accounts sheet after your vault exists.
ob.import.title: Enter your recovery phrase
ob.passkey.body: Your face or fingerprint unlocks the vault on this device. Your password still works, and it is still needed to reveal or export the phrase.
ob.passkey.noprf: This browser created a passkey without the PRF feature, so it cannot unlock the vault on its own. Use your password.
ob.passkey.title: Unlock with a passkey?
ob.password.body: It seals your vault on this device. A few unrelated words beat a short string of symbols. We cannot reset it.
ob.password.title: Choose a password
ob.preview.body: Wallets derive accounts along two common trees. BoltVault uses the standard (BIP-44) tree; Ledger Live uses another. Both agree on the first address.
ob.preview.title: Which addresses do you recognise?
ob.quiz.body: Type the words at these positions. This is the backup check that unlocks swapping and signing.
ob.quiz.title: Confirm three words
ob.watch.body: You will see balances and activity but cannot send or sign. Add a key or pair a device later.
ob.watch.title: Watch an address
ob.welcome.body: BoltVault keeps your recovery phrase on this device, sealed with your password. Nothing leaves it unless you export it.
ob.welcome.title: Your keys, your Electroneum
ob.words.body: This is the only copy. Anyone with these words controls your funds; BoltVault will never ask for them except on this screen and the quiz.
ob.words.title: Write these 12 words down, in order
offers.obligation: Your open offers commit {o} WETN; you hold {b} WETN.
offers.title: Offers
piece.earns: This piece earns marketplace dividends — {a} ETN unclaimed
piece.earns.none: This piece earns marketplace dividends (activate them after you hold it).
piece.list.title: List for sale
piece.offer.body: Offers are made in WETN. If you are short, the wallet wraps ETN for you first. The owner can accept any time before it expires.
piece.offer.title: Make an offer
piece.proceeds: You receive {a} ETN after the 3% marketplace fee{c}
piece.transfer.body: The recipient goes through the same address checks as a send. A collectible cannot be recalled.
piece.transfer.title: Send this piece
pw.ok: Usable — a longer phrase is stronger
quiz.wrong: Those words do not match your phrase. Check the numbers and try again.
rack.empty: Nothing on the shelves yet. Explore collections on Electroneum — buying a piece lands it here.
rack.title: Your collection
receive.request.hint: The code above updates with the amount.
receive.title: Receive
receive.warning: This is Electroneum Smart Chain (52014). Send ETN here from an exchange that supports the smart chain. Do not send from the old Electroneum app.
remote.body: This account signs on a paired device. Open BoltVault there — the request appears as a signing sheet with everything it is about to sign.
remote.kind.msg: Waiting for the message to be signed
remote.kind.tx: Waiting for the transaction to be signed
remote.kind.typed: Waiting for the typed data to be signed
remote.title: Sign on another device
reveal.body: Enter your password. Make sure nobody can see your screen.
reveal.title: Recovery phrase · {label}
security.about: Encryption: Argon2id → XChaCha20-Poly1305, one data key per vault, wrapped per unlock factor.
security.export: Move this vault to another device
security.export.body: An animated code the other device scans, sealed under a one-time phrase you type there. Your seeds never touch the internet.
security.export.hint: Type this on the other device. It is not shown there.
security.passkeys.none: No passkey enrolled. A passkey unlocks the vault with your face or fingerprint on this device; the password stays required for reveal and export.
security.passkeys.unsupported: Passkeys with the PRF feature are not available in this browser or on this device.
security.title: Security
send.note: You will see exactly what moves before you sign. Sending to a contract or a new address asks for a second look.
send.save: Save this address for next time
send.title: Send
settings.approvals.rows: What contracts can move your tokens; revoke
settings.devices.rows: Pair a phone or browser; move your vault
settings.networks.rows: Which chains show, custom RPCs, testnet
settings.notifications.rows: Watchlist alerts, campaigns going live, rewards and dividends
settings.spending.rows: Slippage, approvals, step-ups, wallet fee schedule
share.body: Your signature, your name and your tier — never a balance.
share.title: Share card
sites.none: No site is connected. When a site asks to connect, it appears here with the account and chain it sees.
sites.note: Each site keeps its own chain. Changing the Home chain never changes a site.
sites.title: Connected sites
sky.empty: No campaigns right now. Star one from a share link to be told when it goes live.
sky.finalizing: Waiting for the team to finalize
spending.exact.hint: Allow Permit2 only the amount of each swap. Safer; one more transaction per swap of that token.
spending.sink.none: Fee sink not set on this network
spending.slippage.body: How far the price may move between your quote and the block that fills it before the swap gives up.
spending.stepups.body: A first-time recipient pauses for a second look; a send above a tenth of a token balance asks you to unlock again. Both are always on.
swap.coach: Your first swap of a token takes up to three signatures: allow Permit2 once (the shared allowance contract ElectroSwap uses), permit this exact amount, then the swap itself. ETN in needs only the swap.
swap.coach.fee: The wallet fee comes out of what you receive; holding BOLT lowers it. Tap the fee line for the schedule.
token.market.none: Market data arrives from ElectroSwap once the wallet key is enabled on the API.
token.market.other: No safety or market data for tokens outside Electroneum.
trezor.unavailable: A Trezor connects from the browser extension. On the phone you can watch its address and sign on your paired computer — pair it under Settings › Devices.
unlock.help: Forgot the password? There is no reset. Restore from your recovery phrase on a fresh install instead.
unlock.passkey.fail: The passkey did not unlock the vault. Use your password.
unlock.title: Unlock BoltVault
unlock.wrong: That password does not open this vault.
watch.label: Watch address
watch.only: Watch-only — import a key or pair a device.
wc.body: Paste or scan a wc: link from a site. The site then asks to connect like any other, and its signatures come through the same sheet.
wc.title: WalletConnect
wc.web: WalletConnect lives in the phone app. In the browser, BoltVault is already in every tab.
